property_snapshot.Garrison: Permanent: a Sigrún-designed binding cell (the cage) + a crystal-network node keyed to the captured broker. Standing security detail on the binding — not against intruders but against the prisoner's escape and the prisoner's patrons. Access restricted to inner circle + the four integration principals. No general staff; the room's product is too sensitive for scribes.
property_snapshot.Name: The Tally Room — Dalelands War-Accounting Facility
property_snapshot.Notes: The war room. A chamber cut into the granite BELOW The Ledge, where the captured arcanaloth Vhaeric the Tallykeeper is bound and wired into the arterial crystal network as its soul-ledger RECORDER (not predictor). Produces: (1) running soul-count of Dalelands casualties, both sides, broken by destination — how many to Hell, how many the Shepherd kept, how many the Whisper returned; (2) champion-fragment intelligence at a faster clock than Veil field work. Does NOT predict where the next battle pays best (ruled out at design). Standing up the room forces the Network Audit decision — you do not wire a fiend into a Cascading-load network and hope. Built 2026-09-01.
property_snapshot.Source File: Design build 2026-09-01 (this chat). Governs: War-Room Accounting SysRef (pending); The Network Audit thread; Vhaeric NPC.

property_snapshot.Name: The Sallow Pit (Field Ward, Waterdeep)
property_snapshot.Notes: Flooded clay quarry, north edge of the Field Ward at the Trollwall. 160 ft across, 30 ft deep, flooded to half. North wall is wet undercut clay that sloughs. The Field Ward's execution ground (drowning; rope costs money). Rudeus Greyrat's landing point Day 743; site of the Day 752 wrongful drowning of Corrado Vesce and the rim collapse (24 in the crowd, 7 in the water). Since Day 752 a raw stone wall stands across the north face that nobody chanted for.

property_snapshot.Notes: Lay Umberlant altar beneath a Dock Ward boathouse; Håkon Sverling's oath-site. The Sallow Pit drownings are its offerings; the reeve's boats have lost no man in three years. Quest site for Rudeus Greyrat's personal quest (skirmish-scale cult site). NOT a Kenafin thread — keep separate (canon lock). Exact boathouse and pier to be fixed in play; do not pre-decide.
